description: This file defines the domain model for representing a Loan Schedule within the Fineract system. It includes data structures for loan periods, total calculations, and conversion methods to data transfer objects.

classes.name: LoanScheduleModel
classes.description: Domain representation of a Loan Schedule, encapsulating periods, total amounts, and related metadata. Designed for in-memory computation and transformation into data transfer objects.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static factory method to create a LoanScheduleModel instance with specified data.

methods.name: withOverdueChargeUpdation
methods.description: Static method to create a new LoanScheduleModel instance with updated overdue charges.

methods.name: withLoanScheduleModelPeriods
methods.description: Static method to create a LoanScheduleModel with a specified list of periods, based on an existing model.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Transforms the LoanScheduleModel into a LoanScheduleData DTO for external use.
